item.title: Sudanese medical group accuses paramilitary force of killing 27 in attack targeting civilians
item.description: A Sudanese medical group says attacks in central Sudan have killed 27 people, including elderly individuals

item.title: Kenyan police arrest 8 students on suspicion of arson after deadly girls school fire
item.description: Kenyan police have arrested eight female students on suspicion of arson after a fire destroyed a dormitory at a boarding school

item.title: Truck carrying Afghan refugees returning from Pakistan crashes in eastern Afghanistan, killing 18
item.description: An Afghan Taliban official says a truck carrying Afghan refugees returning from Pakistan has overturned on a highway in eastern Afghanistan, killing at least 18 people, most of them women and children

item.title: Canadian man expected to plead guilty to selling lethal substances to people who killed themselves
item.description: A Canadian man accused of selling lethal substances online to people who took them to end their own lives is expected to plead guilty to 14 counts of counseling or aiding suicide

item.title: Asia's defense summit opens with China and doubts about US priorities topping concerns
item.description: China's military modernization and assertiveness in the Indo-Pacific are key topics at Asia's top defense summit

item.title: Russian drone launched against Ukraine crashes in Romania, injuring 2
item.description: Romanian authorities say a Russian drone that was part of an overnight attack on Ukraine crashed into an apartment building in eastern Romania

item.title: Philippine court orders senator's arrest for large-scale corruption; he surrenders
item.description: A Philippine anti-graft court has ordered the arrest of Senator Jinggoy Estrada over allegations of pocketing millions in a flood-control project

item.title: President of Myanmar's military-backed government visits India
item.description: Myanmar's state media says the leader of Myanmar's military-backed government has embarked on an official visit to India, one of the country's key regional partners

item.title: Bus carrying young athletes crashes in Hungary, killing the driver and injuring 23
item.description: A bus carrying young athletes to a competition in Hungary veered into the opposing lane and collided with a tree, killing the driver and injuring nearly two dozen

item.title: Russian spies aggressively seeking Western technology as sanctions bite: Officials
item.description: Russian intelligence agencies have grown more aggressive in their efforts to steal Western technology and defense secrets as sanctions squeeze the country's wartime economy
